title: Release export: "Attempt to disconnect a nonexistent connection ... Signal: 'tree_exited'" when resetting a SceneMultiplayer peer after an RPC
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible (release export template only): v4.7.2.stable.official [ed1daf0bf], v4.7.stable.official [5b4e0cb0f]
- Not reproducible with the same project: editor binary, and the v4.7.2 **debug** export template

### System information

Ubuntu 24.04.4 LTS (x86_64), headless (`--headless`), Linux export templates from the official 4.7.2 / 4.7 downloads

### Issue description

Replacing the `multiplayer_peer` of a `SceneMultiplayer` after at least one RPC has been sent through it prints, in a **release** export only:

```
ERROR: Attempt to disconnect a nonexistent connection from 'Endpoint:<Node#25350374771>'. Signal: 'tree_exited', callable: ''.
```

`SceneCacheInterface` connects each cached node with a **bound** callable and `CONNECT_ONE_SHOT`:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/ed1daf0bf/modules/multiplayer/scene_cache_interface.cpp#L46

but `SceneCacheInterface::clear()` disconnects the **unbound** form:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/ed1daf0bf/modules/multiplayer/scene_cache_interface.cpp#L301

The same two lines are unchanged on `master`. The debug template disconnects cleanly; the release template reports the connection as nonexistent, so matching the unbound callable against the bound connection appears to behave differently between build types. This looks related to #95512 (release-only `tree_exiting` disconnect error, GCC LTO) and to #119740 / #120394, but #120394 is already in 4.7.1+ and this still reproduces on 4.7.2.

Workaround (verified with the MRP below, release template, 3/3 clean runs): free every node that was used for an RPC before changing or clearing the peer, so its one-shot `tree_exited` callback removes the cache entry first. Adding `endpoint.free()` before the peer reset removes the error.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create the three files below in an empty project with `run/main_scene="res://main.tscn"` (a `main.tscn` with a single `Node` root using `main.gd`).
2. Export with the Linux preset using the **release** template (`--export-release`).
3. Run the exported binary with `--headless`. It prints `REPRO RPC DELIVERED`, `REPRO RESET LIVE API` and the error above, then exits.
4. Run the same project from the editor binary, or a debug export: no error.

`main.gd`:

```gdscript
extends Node

var host_api: SceneMultiplayer
var client_api: SceneMultiplayer
var endpoint: Node
var sent := false
var closed := false
var started := 0

func _ready() -> void:
	started = Time.get_ticks_msec()
	var host := Node.new()
	host.name = "Host"
	add_child(host)
	host_api = SceneMultiplayer.new()
	get_tree().set_multiplayer(host_api, host.get_path())
	var client := Node.new()
	client.name = "Client"
	add_child(client)
	client_api = SceneMultiplayer.new()
	get_tree().set_multiplayer(client_api, client.get_path())
	var server_endpoint := Node.new()
	server_endpoint.name = "Endpoint"
	server_endpoint.set_script(preload("res://endpoint.gd"))
	host.add_child(server_endpoint)
	endpoint = Node.new()
	endpoint.name = "Endpoint"
	endpoint.set_script(preload("res://endpoint.gd"))
	client.add_child(endpoint)
	var server_peer := ENetMultiplayerPeer.new()
	server_peer.create_server(28998, 2)
	host_api.multiplayer_peer = server_peer
	var client_peer := ENetMultiplayerPeer.new()
	client_peer.create_client("127.0.0.1", 28998)
	client_api.multiplayer_peer = client_peer

func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
	host_api.poll()
	client_api.poll()
	if not sent and client_api.get_peers().has(1):
		sent = true
		endpoint.ping.rpc_id(1)
	if sent and not closed and Time.get_ticks_msec() - started > 1000:
		closed = true
		print("REPRO RESET LIVE API")
		client_api.multiplayer_peer = OfflineMultiplayerPeer.new()
		get_tree().quit()
	if Time.get_ticks_msec() - started > 5000:
		get_tree().quit(2)
```

`endpoint.gd`:

```gdscript
extends Node

@rpc("any_peer", "reliable")
func ping() -> void:
	print("REPRO RPC DELIVERED")
```

`project.godot` needs only `run/main_scene` (tested with `renderer/rendering_method="gl_compatibility"`).

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Inline above (three small files); the CLI used to file this cannot attach a zip. Happy to attach one if needed.
